gr_list.description: Tedavi Sonrasi Takip Otomasyonu (T+1, T+7, T+30 follow-up zinciri)
Tedavi Plani Onay Akisi (T+1, T+3, T+7 plan approval follow-up)
Tedavi Oncesi Hazirlik Talimatlari (T-3, T-1, T-sabah pre-op mesajlari)

plan.summary: TreatmentLifecycleService: Ortak IHostedService ile 3 saglik yasam dongusu otomasyonu (post-treatment, plan-approval, pre-op). 2 yeni DB tablosu, 5 yeni endpoint, Backend proxy, Outbound entegrasyonu.
plan.q_intent: PKT-6C1 Health Automation: GR-3.20 Tedavi Sonrasi Takip + GR-3.41 Tedavi Plani Onay + GR-3.43 Pre-op Hazirlik. Ortak TreatmentLifecycleService pattern. GR-3.44 ertelendi (GR-3.31 bagimlilik).
plan.interview_notes: Q kararlari: (1) PKT-6C split: 6C1 (3 GR health automation) + 6C2 (5 GR marketing+multilingual). (2) GR-3.44 ertelendi (GR-3.31 Guardrail bagimliligi). (3) Ortak TreatmentLifecycleService pattern. (4) PKT-6C1 once.

verification_questions.question: Do ALL treatment_followups and treatment_followup_steps queries include tenant_id WHERE clause for multi-tenant isolation?
Does TreatmentLifecycleService use Interlocked.CompareExchange for overlap prevention, matching ReminderSchedulerService pattern?
Are all new DB-calling endpoints (both in Appointments and Backend proxy) wrapped with NpgsqlException typed catches?
Does the step scheduling correctly handle both positive offsets (post-treatment T+1d) and negative offsets (pre-op T-3d) relative to reference_date?
Are all fire-and-forget operations logged with ContinueWith(OnlyOnFaulted) and never swallowed silently?
Does the escalation path work correctly: complaint_detected or no_response_after_final_step triggers Outbound alert to doctor/supervisor?

non_goals: Knowledge service integration for pre-op template retrieval (future enhancement)
GR-3.44 Recete/Ilac Sorgulari (ertelendi, GR-3.31 Guardrail bagimliligi)
intentional_exclusions: Dynamic step configuration via DB/API (hardcoded step definitions sufficient for v1)
Patient sentiment analysis on responses (future GR-3.24 scope)

user_facing_errors: INV-AP-016: Invalid lifecycle start request payload
INV-AP-018: Lifecycle already completed or cancelled
INV-AP-019: Invalid lifecycle type (must be post_treatment, plan_approval, or pre_op)
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: All error paths have typed catches with logging. TreatmentLifecycleService follows ReminderSchedulerService pattern with per-step error handling and batch-level logging.

verdict.notes: Chunk 1 PASS (iter 0), Chunk 2 FORCE PASS (Q override - GetDueStepsAsync is cross-tenant scheduler by design, Codex false positive on tenant_id filter for 8 iterations), Chunk 3 PASS (iter 7). Real bug found iter 4: HandleLastStepAsync escalation logic fixed.
